Native Oberfläche für die ClamAV-Automat:
Native interface for ClamAV automation on Apple Silicon.

Ad-hoc signed, without a certificate; not notarized by Apple.

Homebrew is installed automatically if needed. Every installation refreshes the package information and installs the latest stable ClamAV version available there.

ClamAV is a scheduled scanner, not real-time protection for macOS.
1. Sprache wählen und „Installieren / ak:
1. Choose a language and click “Install / update”. Homebrew will be installed automatically if missing. An administrator password or Apple’s developer tools may be required.

2. Grant Full Disk Access manually using the access guide.

3. Click “Restart & test scan” and wait for the result. Scheduled scans run in the logged-in user account even when the app is closed.

4. To remove the automation, choose “Uninstall…”. Data will be archived. You can optionally remove the shared ClamAV package; Homebrew will be preserved.

The interface is translated. Technical logs from the installer, Homebrew and ClamAV remain in their original language.

Do not open quarantined files. Cloud files, encrypted content and size limits may limit scanning. Full Disk Access may need to be granted again after updates.

After a successful uninstall, a reminder about remaining privacy permissions appears. The app automatically opens Full Disk Access in System Settings. Manually disable or remove any permissions you no longer need there.

During setup, the app shows the current step, its progress, elapsed time and the latest message. The percentage counts setup steps and is not a time estimate. Password and confirmation prompts appear at the top of the window.

Each time it starts, the app uses the macOS system language. If that language is not supported, the app opens in English. A manual language selection applies only to the current window.

If the Homebrew package remains after uninstallation, the app reports this separately. Choose “Remove ClamAV package…” to retry removal. If needed, protected ClamAV program folders are repaired after a prompt for your administrator password. Archives and logs will be preserved.
Die bisherigen täglichen Scans, Signatur: The previous daily scans, signature updates and Homebrew background service will be stopped. Their job files and the old scan script will be archived. Quarantine files and logs will stay in their current locations. Homebrew, the ClamAV package and its shared configuration will be kept.
